youtube.title: One Sentence That Cost Him Everything | Polycarp #shorts
youtube.text:
The true story of Polycarp of Smyrna. The governor said, Curse Christ. The old man answered with one sentence: "Eighty and six years have I served Him, and He hath done me no wrong."

Full story: https://youtu.be/Z8OuFTS-pTg

From the Martyrdom of Polycarp, the letter the church in Smyrna wrote after his death, around AD 155.

Type amen, and send this to a friend who needs it.

#shorts #polycarp #christianmartyrs #churchhistory #faith
